enchantment.lamplight.adrenaline.desc: Falling into danger grants a surge of speed.
enchantment.lamplight.aerodynamics.desc: Sprinting in midair grants a burst of forward speed.
enchantment.lamplight.bloom.desc: Increases the chance for leaves to drop saplings or sticks.
enchantment.lamplight.chain_load.desc: You can fire two arrows every time you load one.
enchantment.lamplight.cinderheart.desc: Each hit builds Kindling; the hit after three stacks detonates in area fire damage.
enchantment.lamplight.cold_steel.desc: Hits may give your attacker Mining Fatigue.
enchantment.lamplight.cometfall.desc: Slamming into the ground with riptide deals AoE damage.
enchantment.lamplight.coyote.desc: You can jump after leaving the ground for a small window.
enchantment.lamplight.darkness_cloak.des: Hits may afflict your attacker with Darkness.
enchantment.lamplight.dash.desc: Press sneak in midair to dash forward.
enchantment.lamplight.deadeye.desc: First shots against your opponent deal more damage.
enchantment.lamplight.deep_gaze.desc: You see clearly beneath the water.
enchantment.lamplight.double_jump.desc: Press jump in midair to jump again.
enchantment.lamplight.dragonheart.desc: Increases your maximum health and slowly regenerates it.
enchantment.lamplight.echo.desc: Each hit echoes for additional damage.
enchantment.lamplight.ember_tread.desc: You do not take damage from walking on magma
enchantment.lamplight.emberforge.desc: Consumes fire damage to grant you strength.
enchantment.lamplight.feint.desc: A hit after whiffing deals extra damage
enchantment.lamplight.finale.desc: Kills explode with fire, ingiting nearby mobs.
enchantment.lamplight.fire_shield.desc: Hits may set your attacker on fire.
enchantment.lamplight.first_blood.desc: Your first hit against an opponent deals more damage.
enchantment.lamplight.flurry.desc: Hitting in quick succession increases attack speed.
enchantment.lamplight.frost.desc: Arrows freeze and slow struck mobs.
enchantment.lamplight.gravecaller.desc: Hits shroud the target in Darkness and Wither. Wounded enemies can be executed.
enchantment.lamplight.gravedigger.desc: You get a small chance to drop an entity's head.
enchantment.lamplight.grovekeeper.desc: Regenerates health and restores hunger; periodically cleanses one debuff.
enchantment.lamplight.heartwood.desc: Heals you as you strike; healing beyond full health becomes absorption.
enchantment.lamplight.heavy.desc: Hits with this weapon act as a weakened mace.
enchantment.lamplight.heavy_draw.desc: You deal more damage at the cost of having a longer loading time.
enchantment.lamplight.ice_aspect.desc: Melee hits freeze and slow your target.
enchantment.lamplight.icebound.desc: Attackers are slowed. Heavily frozen attackers take extra damage.
enchantment.lamplight.inferno.desc: Using the trident propels yourself when on fire.
enchantment.lamplight.jockey.desc: Mounts ride faster and jump higher.
enchantment.lamplight.kiln.desc: You deal more damage while on fire.
enchantment.lamplight.kiln_hands.desc: You have a chance to smelt mined ore.
enchantment.lamplight.kiting.desc: You move faster while charging a crossbow
enchantment.lamplight.knockshot.desc: Hit arrows deal knockback to nearby entities.
enchantment.lamplight.lamplight.desc: You emit light and cannot be affected by Darkness
enchantment.lamplight.last_stand.desc: At low health you are slowed but gain damage reduction
enchantment.lamplight.leech.desc: Thrown tridents latch onto hit entities, healing you and dealing damage over time.
enchantment.lamplight.magnum_opus.desc: Harvests, and kills, grant extra experience and sometimes extra drops.
enchantment.lamplight.marked_quarry.desc: Struck foes are marked and take more damage while marked.
enchantment.lamplight.momentum.desc: Sprinting allows you to deal more knockback.
enchantment.lamplight.propulsion.desc: Firework rockets fired from this crossbow propel you forward.
enchantment.lamplight.provisioner.desc: Restores hunger and gives water breathing and night vision while worn.
enchantment.lamplight.reap.desc: Hits deal additional damage to any entity behind the one you hit.
enchantment.lamplight.reeling.desc: Thrown tridents will deal true damage, reel in hit entities, and have a cooldown.
enchantment.lamplight.rend.desc: Your hits afflict a DoT bleed.
lamplight.rend.title: Bleeding
enchantment.lamplight.ricochet.desc: Arrows can hit an additional target.
enchantment.lamplight.riposte.desc: After taking damage, your attacks deal more damage.
enchantment.lamplight.scavenger.desc: You have a chance to not use an arrow when firing.
enchantment.lamplight.scholar.desc: You gain more experience from blocks and mobs.
enchantment.lamplight.severing.desc: Your hits ignore part of the target's armor.
enchantment.lamplight.shroud.desc: A darkness aura surrounds you; while badly hurt, you gain lifesteal.
enchantment.lamplight.singe.desc: Arrows that miss briefly light the ground.
enchantment.lamplight.smoke_veil.desc: Impacts leave a cloud that confuses mobs.
enchantment.lamplight.spines.desc: You deal a little damage back to enemies that hit you.
enchantment.lamplight.spite.desc: You deal extra damage when below half health.
enchantment.lamplight.splinter.desc: Breaking a shield stuns your opponent.
enchantment.lamplight.static_charge.desc: You deal additional thunder damage every third hit.
enchantment.lamplight.sticky_landing.des: You ignore some fall damage, and bounce.
enchantment.lamplight.storm_coil.desc: Being hit can increase your next melee damage.
enchantment.lamplight.stormbrand.desc: Aditional damage while wet or in rain.
enchantment.lamplight.stormward.desc: Dashing grants brief Speed and a window of high resistance and lightning retaliation.
enchantment.lamplight.sunder.desc: Hits shred through armor, and blocked attacks shatter shields.
enchantment.lamplight.sure_footed.desc: Increased step height and decreased ice slipperiness.
enchantment.lamplight.tailwind.desc: Arrows fired while in the air deal more damage.
enchantment.lamplight.thunderstep.desc: After a dash, your next hit discharges extra thunder damage.
enchantment.lamplight.tiller.desc: You can't trample farmland, and gain extra benefits from bonemeal.
enchantment.lamplight.trencher.desc: Mining with a shovel mines additional blocks.
enchantment.lamplight.unbroken.desc: You gain damage resistance and knockback resistance.
enchantment.lamplight.undertow.desc: Your hits drag entities toward you.
enchantment.lamplight.updraft.desc: You have a chance to shoot arrows with levitation.
enchantment.lamplight.venom.desc: You have a chance for arrows to have poison.
enchantment.lamplight.viper.desc: You have a chance to deal poison damage.
enchantment.lamplight.vulture.desc: Deal extra damage to entities with low health.
enchantment.lamplight.warding_sigil.desc: You take less damage from magic.
enchantment.lamplight.web_walker.desc: You are slowed less by cobwebs.
enchantment.lamplight.whirlwind.desc: Sweeping attacks deal additional knockback and have additional reach.
enchantment.lamplight.windrunner.desc: Shots grow faster and stronger while you keep moving.
enchantment.lamplight.winters_edge.desc: Hits build Chill until the target freezes. Frozen enemies take extra damage and shatter when slain.
enchantment.lamplight.zephyr.desc: Chance to dodge direct attacks, deflects projectiles, and breaks falls safely.
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: Lets you mine underwater at normal speed.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Deals extra damage to shields and armor.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces fire damage and shortens burning.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Your bow never runs out of arrows.
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc: Increases drops from mobs killed with melee or ranged weapons.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: Lets a spear vault you forward.
enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc: Fish bite faster, and rare catches come more often.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: Crossbows fire multiple arrows at once.
enchantment.minecraft.power.desc: Arrows deal more damage by weight.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces damage from arrows and other projectiles.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Launches you with the trident in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Increases movement speed on soul sand and soul soil.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Chance to damage attackers when hit.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: You get launched up after slamming.
